ORDINANCE VIII OF 2002
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE VIII OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend
the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
9th February, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
9-2-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
1. Short title and commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called
the Code of Criminal Procedure (Amendment) Ordinance, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

sections.shortTitle: Code of Criminal Procedure First Amendment Ordinance 2002
sections.description:
Amendment of section 491, Act V of 1898

ORDINANCE VIII OF 2002
CODE OF CRIMINAL PROCEDURE (AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2002
ORDINANCE VIII OF 2002
(An Ordinance further to amend
the Code of Criminal Procedure, 1898)
[Gazette of Pakistan, Extraordinary, Part I,
9th February, 2002]
F. No.2(1)/2002-Pub., dated
9-2-2002.---The following Ordinance promulgated by the President is hereby
published for general information:---
2. Amendment of section 491, Act V of 1898.---In the Code of
Criminal Procedure, 1898 (Act V of 1898), in section 491, after sub section (1)
the following new subsection shall be inserted, namely:---
"(1A) The
High Court may, by general or special order published in the official Gazette,
direct that all or any of its powers specified in clauses (a) and (b) of
subsection (1) shall, subject to such conditions, if any, as may be specified
in the order, be exercisable also by---
(a) a Sessions
Judge; or
(b) an
Additional Sessions Judge,
within the
territorial limits of a Sessions Division."
